static_traits.name: 陈Hai Li
static_traits.educational_background: Has attended cooking courses and workshops
static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友支持与鼓励，但因对烹饪的Self-doubt而倾向自我隔离、减少与亲友交流
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before；not yet有类似心理问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述自动化思维与目标，配合度高；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 在烹饪节目试镜失败后，我开始相信have not人欣赏我的料理，甚至觉得人们not喜欢我这个人；这使我对自己的烹饪能力产生怀疑并感到Being rejected。
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative self-talk and doubt about cooking ability affect my motivation and self-esteem; I hope to gain support, walk out of these negative thoughts, and rebuild confidence in cooking.
growth_experiences: 一次重要的烹饪节目试镜失败：评审反馈为“菜品缺乏灵感且not够平衡”，结果公布后开始出现“without人欣赏我的料理、他人not喜欢我”的信念。此后Cooking for others或收到反馈时，会在脑中反复回想评审的声音（例如“你的料理not够好”“not人喜欢你的菜”），逐步导致Decreased drive、Increased self-doubt、与朋友家人关系疏远，并伴随情绪和饮食习惯变化。

core_beliefs: 我的料理not够好、not值得被认可

special_situations.event: 烹饪节目试镜失败并收到评审反馈（称“菜品缺乏灵感且not够平衡”）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一次重要试镜失败，就说明我have not天赋、整体not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续做饭并主动寻求反馈来证明与提升自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not人欣赏我的料理；他们not喜欢我

special_situations.event: Cooking for others或在用餐后收到反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有人指出not足，就等于他们not喜欢我这个人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少与亲友联系、避免社交以躲开评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们讨厌我的烹饪，甚至not喜欢我

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 积极反馈not可信，do not人只是客套
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客气，并not是真心喜欢

special_situations.event: 他人对菜品提出轻微批评或改进建议
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 出现任何负面意见就代表整体失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复在脑中重播评审的批评，降低烹饪动力
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的菜not够好；have not人会喜欢它

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and liked, hoping his work is appreciated and his value seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与Being rejected，担心自己not值得被喜欢
defense_goal: 通过与他人保持距离来降低被negate的风险
通过not断寻求外部反馈来试图证明自身价值

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、批判的他人（评审/受众）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当他人对其料理给予正面反馈或赞美时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将赞美理解为not真诚的客套（移情：将外界的正面信号视为not可相信）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用解释性语句将赞美归为“客套/礼貌”，语气平淡，迅速Displacement话题，并强调对方“只是not好意思直说”。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当他人提出轻微批评或改进建议时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将部分批评等同为对自我整体的negate，认为“他们not喜欢我”（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我批评的语句（如“都是我not行”），语气低落，主动回避进一步交流，表达退出或Reduced socializing的意愿。

试镜失败后对作为Chef的价值与热情产生动摇

在烹饪时反复在脑中回放评审声音

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
